_instructions: For each dye and use, set status to one of: approved, restricted, banned, not_approved, not_listed. Fill 'source' with the exact regulation or list and its date. Leave 'TODO' if unverified (the app treats TODO as no data). Sources: ECHA (REACH Annex XVII) for textiles; EU food additives register / FDA colour additive lists for food; EU Cosmetics Regulation colourant annexes for cosmetics. CAS numbers below are from memory: verify. The smiles must match the structure used in the app.
